name: x5-recruitment-monorepo
description: X5 Tech Internship Recruitment System - Monorepo

scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others "docker compose up -d postgres" "npm run wait-for-db && npm run backend:dev" "npm run wait-for-backend && npm run frontend:dev"
scripts.wait-for-db: bash -c 'for i in {1..30}; do docker exec x5-recruitment-db pg_isready -U recruitment && sleep 2 && exit 0; sleep 1; done; echo "Timeout waiting for DB"; exit 1'
scripts.wait-for-backend: bash -c 'for i in {1..60}; do curl -s http://localhost:8080/actuator/health > /dev/null 2>&1 && sleep 2 && exit 0; sleep 1; done; echo "Timeout waiting for backend"; exit 1'
scripts.backend:dev: cd apps/backend && export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/temurin-21-jdk-amd64 && export PATH=$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH && mvn spring-boot:run
scripts.backend:build: cd apps/backend && export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/temurin-21-jdk-amd64 && export PATH=$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH && mvn clean package
